text:
Predicates:
InCity(x, y) ::: x is a city in y.
InState(x, y) ::: x is in state y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
State(x) ::: x is a state.
SameState(x, y) ::: x and y are in the same state.
Premises:
Montana in U.S. ::: Montana is a state in the U.S.
InCity(butte, montana) ::: Butte is in Montana.
InCity(helena, montana) ::: Helena is in Montana.
InCity(missoula, montana) ::: Missoula is in Montana.
InCity(whiteSulphurSprings, montana) ::: White Sulphur Springs is in Montana.
InCity(stPierre, nonMontana) ::: St Pierre is not in Montana.
InCity(butte, stateX) ∧ InCity(stPierre, stateY) → ¬(stateX = stateY) ::: Any city in Butte is not in St Pierre.
City(x) → ∃y (InCity(x, y)) ::: Every city is in some state.
Conclusion:
SameState(butte, stPierre) ?
